summary_en: This paper improves compressive near-field acoustic holography by weighting transfer-matrix modes according to their physical stability and replacing phase-blind atom selection with a cosine-similarity criterion that accounts for both magnitude and phase. An adaptive GCV procedure removes manual tuning. Simulations and a semi-anechoic vibrating-plate experiment support robust reconstruction under sparse sampling and noise, making it a direct core acoustic-imaging addition.

summary_en: This work introduces a Janus acoustic metascreen that independently manipulates amplitude and phase in both transmission and reflection, enabling four holographic information channels from a single input. The demonstrated generation, encryption, and decryption of bidirectional amplitude and phase images make it a strong acoustic-holography and wavefront-encoding addition, although its primary application is secure acoustic communication rather than sensing.

summary_en: The method separates weak transient pulse sources from strong harmonic interference using continuous-wavelet-transform preprocessing, then reconstructs the pulse field with the time-domain equivalent source method. A theoretical transfer-consistency analysis, simulations, and a compressor experiment support the approach. Because it directly advances transient acoustic image formation and source localization, it belongs in the main acoustic-holography library.
